content: PortPrototype may belong to more than one PortGroup s A PortPrototype may belong to more than one PortGroup s and PortGroup s can be associated with the “inner” PortGroup s of SwComponentPrototype s which are aggregated by the same SwComponentType as the PortGroup . By this, PortGroup s can be locally defined but still traced down the component hier- archy.
